items.name: an emerald-set gold spike
raw_inspect: You see nothing unusual.
You notice that your gold spike could be worn in your right nostril, though you could probably wear the spike in just about any facial piercing if you flipped it a bit.
You determine that the spike is a piece of piercing jewelry currently meant to be worn in the right nostril.

Analysis of an emerald-set gold spike indicates this is a scripted piercing jewelry item, where the creator has provided the following information:
Name: Flippable Piercing Jewelry
Specific location: right nostril
Displays as: an emerald-set gold spike in his right nostril

Verbs trapped: WEAR/REMOVE, POUR (on), CAST, LOOK/SHOW, PULL, TOUCH, RUB, LICK (for lip only), PUSH.  Also see PIERCE HELP.  You can also FLIP to use the spike in all facial piercing slots (but if the noun/item is singular, it cannot be worn in dual slots).

Merchant Services:  Alterations should ensure that non-flippable items retain a matched noun and pierced slot; all others must have a generalized enough noun to logically sit in ANY eligible piercing slot.  Avoid naming the body part in the base/long (when worn, a description gets added denoting placement).  The specific location and/or singular/plural status CAN be changed by general merchants.  Changing an item from static to flippable or flippable to static is currently only offered by select merchants as a special service.
You get no sense of whether or not the spike may be further lightened.
The gold spike will cost 100,000 coins.

Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be.  The razor must be cleansed and sharpened to get the most of out the item, but over time, the razor will break apart, unless you obtain a special one that will never dull.

If something is temporarily altering your features, you will need to remove or stop whatever it is before being scarred.  There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.
Scar Selection:

To choose how you scar, you must PUSH to select what you'd like to change and PULL to cycle through the choices available.  Custom scars are possible to get from a merchant who can work on the razors.  To select a custom scar, you'd need to TURN the razor.
Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be. There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.

Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.

~*~ Nervestaves ~*~
SCRIPT DETAILS
The staff has a mechanical (combat) script which provides three basic types of functionality that can be broken down into the following categories:

AFFINITY - A special, custom 'bonding' like mechanism.  Any given item can share an Affinity with only one person at a time.  Affinity is gained by wielding the item and landing successful hits against like level foes.

BACKLASH - Potential negative effects, including immobilization, stuns, and nervous system damage, that can occur at random.  As the wielder's Affinity with the item grows, the chance of a Backlash occurring are reduced.

FLARES   - Off-the-Shelf, this item comes with a 'Muscle Memory' flare that, when triggered, will temporarily enhance the wielder's Combat Maneuver Ranks.  The magnitude of the enhancement is based on the degree of Affinity shared with the wielder, while the frequency of the flare is determined by the item's tier.

Unlocked items also possess the potential for an offensive 'Misery Unleashed' flare.  This flare can ONLY be triggered when the item is wielded against like level foes by someone with whom a COMPLETE Affinity is shared.

items.name: a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen
raw_inspect: A faint crimson sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You carefully inspect your battle standard.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            V'tull
Deity Primary Color:              Red-lined black
Deity Secondary Color:            Crimson
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 10,300,000 coins.

items.name: a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric
raw_inspect: The baldric is constructed of layers of storm grey suede and looks like it would be worn cross-torso from shoulder to hip.  Four rows of two faceted glyphs form the baldric's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  One of the uppermost six glyphs glows a bright blue, while the remaining glyphs in the top three rows are lit by a dim inner light.
It is estimated that a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric can store a small amount with enough space for a couple of items.
The baldric can be worn, slinging it across the shoulders and back.  The baldric appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of leather, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/ivory-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "ivory-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the baldric refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the baldric CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the ivory-adorned baldric, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a white crystal.
This is a Tier 3 baldric, with four tiers in total.  This baldric is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Ivory Adorned Baldric
This baldric CANNOT be deepened at all.
The ivory-adorned baldric will cost 6,499,999 coins.

=General Script Information=
This is armor with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.

items.name: a piece of blue waxpaper
raw_inspect: You see nothing unusual.
This blue waxpaper was designed by Pigments of Memory.  It will allow you to tattoo your body and will give you special messaging based on who the tattoo has been created in memory of.
There are several customization fields still missing from this blue waxpaper, however, a talented merchant can continue to work on the tattoo once it is on your body.
The following customizations are in place for a piece of blue waxpaper:
Base Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Show Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Location of Tattoo: Thigh (this can be changed using FLIP)
Your Pigments of Memory tattoo is designed for a lover.  You have created the following customizations for it:
Your Lover's Name is (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
Your Lover is a giantman (this can be changed using TWIST).
Your Lover is male (this can be changed using SPIN).
Your Lover has (Awaiting Eye Color - What is the eye color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) eyes.
Your Lover has (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
A phrase you shared with your Lover is "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)"
A favorite setting of you and your Lover is (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).
An emotional trigger for you and your Lover is (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
When you use the following verbs, this is how your memories will play out:

(Touch) - You brush your fingers against (tattoo), following the curve of the giantman's face towards his temple, and close your eyes as if remembering running your fingers through his (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
(Gaze) - You glance at your (tattoo), your lips quirking at a half-memory of similar shared glances.

(Cover) - You lay your hand over your (tattoo), your eyes slipping closed as a momentary pang of mourning fills you.  That pain is suddenly eased by the memory of his smile, and for a brief moment, you could swear you feel his hand upon yours once again.

(Tickle) - You trace the lines of your (tattoo), your mind wandering to a memory of a time that you and (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) were (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).  You can almost feel his lips at your ear as he whispers, "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)."

(Sob) - As you glance at (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?), you feel your throat suddenly constrict as you are reminded that (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) is no longer at your side.  You absently lay your hand upon your (tattoo), drawing strength in the fact that you have many, many good memories to draw upon.
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your  tattoo.  If you do, then it will appear only when the tattoo is read.
The waxpaper can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of organic material, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a piece of blue waxpaper indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Welcome to Pigments of Memory waxpaper.  The waxpaper will allow you to tattoo your body and give you a special series of customizations for that tattoo.  You may FLIP it to switch the place that you want the tattoo to appear.  You may SPIN it to switch the gender of the portrait.  You may also twist to change the race of the portrait.  Once you have settled your options, you may RAISE it to gain the tattoo.
To see the special tattoo that a piece of blue waxpaper will create, please READ it.
Special Alteration Instructions:

Some tattoo artists have permission to alter the waxpaper, but not all.  Please note, that once on the body, the tattoo cannot be modified, so it is important to have the waxpaper completely modified before raising.
The blue waxpaper will cost 1,500,000 coins.
